'''Dan McGrath''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2000 Tempe tournament]] on 30 July 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down Executor deck]] and [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit deck]], according to Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1069">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-31-the-allen-parsons-project-tempeaz-7-30d1069/ the-allen-parsons-project-tempeaz-7-30], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 31 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-31-the-allen-parsons-project-tempeaz-7-30d1069/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
